svg.title: The four adoption levels
svg.desc: Four levels, describing how much of helmstudio a studio chooses to take. Level 0, nothing: the studio takes none of the three packages and still installs, launches and runs, which has to stay viable or helmstudio is not a launcher. Level 1, css: it takes helm-css only, so it looks like the family and keeps its own identity hue, and stores nothing centrally. Level 2, css and runtime: assets, gallery, records and jobs, behind the studio's own interface. Level 3, all three: the prebuilt gallery, player, terminal and timeline elements. A dashed note records that helm studio init, which would scaffold level 3, is not built. These are not the certification levels, which are a separate idea.
